fields.statement: At ce2b6bdc2: go test -trimpath ./internal/workflow -run TestShipChangeCIFixPrompt PASS (asserts 'Fix the CI findings', 'failing tests, and recognised non-test causes', 'self-check, fmt-check, vet or build-target failure', 'Reproduce each finding locally', 'regenerate them', plus the kept quarantine/bug-filed/commit-only-once-passing/never-push-to-see rules); go test -trimpath ./internal/workflow/... ok; go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/run-ship' ok (255s), run-ship-ci-lint-fix PASS: fake gh lint check stays FAILURE after its one rerun with 'fail render docs/reference/cli.md: differs from what rhiza docs writes' and 'make: *** [Makefile:186: self-check] Error 1' in --log-failed, fake fixer greps those lines from rhiza ship check --json; journal goes pr-green, conflict-triage, gate-triage, ci-triage pass -> ci-fix pass -> render-pr -> pr-green pass -> signoff, with no wait-ci-rerun.
